purpose: Durable per-stage latency knowledge record for the repack/qualification umbrella. Reusable across artifacts/machines; feeds future autonomic research (Canon). Populated from real on-box measurements.

entries.mechanism: R1: dropped st_dev from current_file_identity_matches hard-fail set (mod.rs). st_dev is a mount-time artifact; a remount reassigns it without touching the file. (bytes,inode)+sealed content sha are the real identity.
entries.cacheability: n/a — correctness fix; removes false HARD REFUSE on benign remount
entries.correctness_authority: sealed source-audit shard hashes (content); unit-covered via warm-receipt sibling
entries.negative_science: device/inode/mtime/ctime were ALL hard-fail keys; device changed 16777234->16777233 on remount while inode+bytes byte-identical, causing a total admission refusal. Over-strict identity = fragility, not integrity.
entries.transfer_class: applies to EVERY on-disk identity gate in the codebase (source chain, warm receipt, and any future artifact identity check)

entries.input_identity: packed payload files (18867), warm receipt keyed by manifest_seal
entries.mechanism: R2: dropped st_dev from admission_warm_receipt::identity_matches. Before, a remount's device shift falsely invalidated the warm receipt -> full cold rehash (9585ms) re-paid on every post-reboot startup. After, the warm receipt survives remount so the cold rehash is paid ONCE (pack/first admit).
entries.cacheability: warm receipt under ~/.cache/hawking; valid until file (size/mtime/inode) changes
entries.correctness_authority: cold-verify content sha256 per payload (ultimate); warm path is a fast-accept proxy
entries.negative_science: identity_matches included device -> every reboot = false miss = 9585ms cold rehash. Verified by 2 unit tests (device shift matches; size/mtime/inode changes still invalidate).
entries.transfer_class: same pattern as source-chain; general 'metadata proxy for content-unchanged' should never include st_dev

entries.input_identity: 18867 payload files, 4.294 GB total, one dir
entries.mechanism: LOWER-BOUND (no change yet). load_warm_payloads_bounded_parallel reads all weights into host Arc<[u8]> (parallel lanes, ~8.7 GB/s effective).
entries.correctness_authority: size + header geometry proven; no content rehash on warm
entries.negative_science: MEASURED floor at current format: stat-all 18867 files = 135ms (7.1us/file, irreducible open overhead at this file count); remaining ~355ms is host-residency bandwidth for 4.294GB. Reaching the directive <=100ms target is IMPOSSIBLE at the current 18867-loose-file + host-copy format. It requires (a) packed-blob layout -> 1 open (kills ~135ms), AND (b) mmap + new_buffer_no_copy on unified memory -> weights reach GPU via the mapping (faulted during execution, not admission), removing the ~355ms host copy from the admission stage. BOTH are repack-format changes -> belongs to G002 repack redesign, not a patch to the current artifact.
entries.transfer_class: any many-small-file artifact load; the packed-blob + mmap-no-copy pattern transfers to Q80 and every future packed model

entries.mechanism: OS/Metal pipeline + shader cache (warm). Cold context 1284ms + shader compile 1177ms -> warm 24ms.
entries.negative_science: Metal compile is NOT the startup lever (directive §21 closed; confirmed: warm 24ms).
entries.transfer_class: all Metal runtimes on this machine

entries.mechanism: RECLASSIFIED — real forward compute (prompt prefill dominated), NOT startup. Belongs to the whole-token TPS lane (G009). A Tier-1 SCREEN need not run full generation.
entries.negative_science: directive framed startup as ~98.8% of the wall — true on the COLD path (28137ms). On the WARM path generation is the LARGER half (1288 vs 965 startup).
